answer: One sybil defense is staking: each agent must bond scarce collateral before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand real deposits, so the attack is as heavy as ferrous ore, not a cheap echo of one wallet. Peers slash the bond on misbehavior, and reputation accrues slowly like gas seeping from shale, never minted free. Capital, not headcount, caps an attacker influence.
